responsibility: This is the core RTL machine description for the m68k backend. It defines target constants, attributes, instruction patterns, expanders, recognizers, output templates, splits, and peephole optimizations for Motorola 680x0 and ColdFire code generation, while including the companion predicates.md and constraints.md files and cooperating with separate scheduling and atomic-description fragments. GCC’s RTL expander, combiner, reload, and final emission stages consume this file to map generic RTL operations onto m68k instructions and target-specific instruction sequences.
same_name_distinction: Holds the RTL machine description for the m68k stem: define_insn/define_peephole patterns, attributes, constants, and included predicates/constraints that drive instruction selection and final emission. Unlike m68k.cc it is declarative RTL rather than C++ backend code, unlike m68k.h it is not the preprocessor/macro configuration header, and unlike m68k.opt it does not describe command-line switches.
